title: Sequence-Independent, Single-Primer Amplification of RNA Viruses
author: Gage Moreno

While reaction is on the thermocycler, make a master mix for 1 reaction (scale up as needed) consisting of 2 μL 5X RT buffer, 1 μL 10 mM dNTP, 1 μL water, 0.5 μL 0.1M DTT, and 0.5 μL SSIV RT.
While reaction is on the thermocycler, make a master mix for 1 reaction (scale up as needed) consisting of 1 μL 5X Sequenase buffer, 3.8 μL water, and 0.15 μL Sequenase.
While reaction is on the thermocycler, make a master mix for 1 reaction (scale up as needed) consisting of 0.45 μL Sequenase dilution buffer, and 0.15 μL Sequenase.
Continue onto library prep protocol of your choice.

Create a master mix of TURBO DNase Mix: Add 1 μL TURBO DNase (2 U) (for up to 10 μg RNA in a 50 μL reaction), 5µL TURBO DNase Buffer, and 14µL of H2O per sample. TURBO™ DNase (2 U/µL) Thermo Fisher Catalog #AM2238

steps.title: Filter Sample
steps.instruction: Filter the cell-free liquid to remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Add 280µL cell-free liquid to a 0.22µm centrifuge filter (Costar Catalog #8110).
Centrifuge at 14,000 RPM for 5 minutes.
Transfer 140µL of the filtered sample to a new tube.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the Buffer AVL and linear polyacrylamide (LPA) mix.

substeps.instruction: For one sample, mix 560µL Buffer AVL (QIAamp Viral RNA Mini, Qiagen Catalog #52906) with 5.6µL linear polyacrylamide (5 mg/ml, Thermo Fisher Catalog #AM9520).
Pipet 560µL of this prepared mix into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube. (Note: If sample volume > 140µL, increase Buffer AVL-LPA proportionally, e.g., 1120µL for 280µL sample, and use a larger tube).

steps.title: Lyse Viral Particles
steps.instruction: Lyse the sample using the prepared buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 140µL of plasma, serum, urine, cell-culture supernatant, or cell-free body fluid to the Buffer AVL-LPA.
Mix by pulse-vortexing for 15 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature (15–25°C) for 10 minutes.
Briefly centrifuge the tube to remove drops from the lid.

steps.title: Prepare for RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Add ethanol to the lysate to facilitate RNA binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 560µL ethanol (96–100%) to each sample (increase proportionally if sample volume > 140µL, e.g., 1120µL ethanol for 280µL sample).
Mix by pulse-vortexing for 15 seconds.
Briefly centrifuge the tube to remove drops from the lid.

steps.title: Purify RNA via Spin Column
steps.instruction: Bind and wash RNA using the QIAamp Mini column.

substeps.instruction: Carefully apply 630µL of the solution to the QIAamp Mini column (in a 2 ml collection tube) without wetting the rim.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 6000 x g (8000 rpm) for 1 minute.
Place the column into a clean 2 ml collection tube and discard the filtrate.
Repeat the loading process if the sample volume was greater than 140µL until all lysate is loaded.
Add 500µL Buffer AW2 to the column, close the cap, and centrifuge at full speed (20,000 x g; 14,000 rpm) for 3 minutes.
Optional: Place the column in a new 2 ml collection tube and centrifuge at full speed (14,000 rpm) for 1 minute to eliminate Buffer AW2 carryover.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Place the QIAamp Mini column in a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and discard the old collection tube.
Add 30µL DNase/RNase Free Water (equilibrated to room temperature) to the column.
Close the cap and incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 6000 x g (8000 rpm) for 1 minute.
Transfer 30µL of the eluted nucleic acid to a new microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating DNA from the RNA sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 20µL of TURBO DNase Mix to the 30µL sample.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Clean and Concentrate RNA
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA using Zymo-Spin IC columns.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 volumes of RNA Binding buffer (Zymo Research Catalog #R1015) to the sample (e.g., 100µL buffer + 50µL sample).
Add an equal amount of 100% ethanol (e.g., 150µL) and mix.
Transfer the sample to a Zymo-Spin IC Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge for 30 seconds (14,000 rpm); discard flow-through.
Add 400µL RNA Prep Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 10,000g–16,000g (14,000 rpm) for 30 seconds; discard flow-through.
Add 700µL RNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 10,000g–16,000g (14,000 rpm) for 30 seconds; discard flow-through.
Centrifuge at 10,000g–16,000g (14,000 rpm) for 2 minutes to remove residual wash buffer.
Transfer the column into an RNase-free tube.
Add 8-10µL Nuclease-Free water directly to the column matrix and centrifuge at 10,000g–16,000g (14,000 rpm) for 30 seconds.

steps.title: SISPA Round A: First Strand Synthesis

substeps.instruction: Prepare Primer A working stock: Mix 4µL of 100pmol/1µL stock with 6µL H2O to get 10µL of 40pmol/µL stock.
Add 1µL Primer A working stock to 4µL extracted RNA.
Heat to 65°C for 5 minutes in a thermocycler, then cool at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Add 5µL master mix and incubate at 50°C for 10 minutes.
Add 5µL Sequenase Mix #1 and incubate at 37°C for 8 minutes.
Add 0.6µL Sequenase Mix #2 and incubate at 37°C for 8 minutes.
Add 1µL RNase H and incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: SISPA Round B: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA product from Round A.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a PCR master mix for 1 reaction: 5µL AccuTaq LA 10x Buffer, 2.5µL dNTP mix, 1µL DMSO, 0.5µL AccuTaq LA DNA Polymerase, 35µL nuclease-free water, and 1µL Primer B (do not dilute Primer B).
Add 5µL of product from SISPA Round A to 45µL of the master mix.
Run PCR: 98°C for 30s; 30 cycles of (94°C for 15s, 50°C for 20s, 68°C for 2min); final step 68°C for 10min; hold at 4°C.

steps.title: Purify Amplified cDNA
steps.instruction: Clean the PCR product using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 50µL resuspend AMPure XP beads to 50µL SISPA product (1:1 ratio).
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Spin down briefly in a mini-centrifuge.
Place on a magnetic stand and discard supernatant once the solution turns clear.
Wash with 200µL of 70% EtOH, remove EtOH without disturbing beads; repeat wash once more.
Remove samples from magnetic rack and spin down briefly to remove residual ethanol.
Air dry briefly (do not overdry).
Resuspend sample in 50µL H2O and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Transfer tubes to magnetic rack and transfer 48µL of eluted product to a new tube.
